commits.subject: fix(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): the dev stack's animals frontend caches its templates, and coverage links name the tests as they are titled now

feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): The notification view header, review page and overview follow the service's own patterns in live animals and plants, and their tests find the page the same way
docs(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): the same-as importer on the review reads back name, address lines and country, with no telephone or email

feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): A submitted notification stores no unread list of outstanding items, and whether an amendment changed any answers is always yes or no, on the backend and the local stub alike
fix(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): review page species names read in sentence case
chore(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): relink coverage to the theme review's test titles, and name Consignment addresses on upload documents
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): One name for the exit port, the arrival date and the addresses section on check your answers, the overview and the addresses page
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): A notification with incomplete identifiers still submits, and its confirmation page lists the identifier item
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): A notification submitted without its health certificate is plain Submitted: the Submitted action required status comes out
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): Plants' import reference numbers show its customs document code, C085
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): Submit is refused without a main import reason, the follow-up answers it calls for and what the animals are certified for
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): A draft's review shows the view header with its Draft status and stays editable
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): Tests prove the review, declaration and confirmation paths no test covers today
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): Notification submitted page sends a not-yet-submitted notification to the declaration, and owes the ITAHC until one is uploaded, in animals and plants
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): Submitting records its date and outstanding items, and a notification still missing its health certificate shows as 'Submitted action required'

feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): A submitted notification's view has a header: reference, status and date submitted, with Amend, Copy as new and Delete, and the import reference numbers as text to copy
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): Review ends with Continue and Delete, and an amendment's review offers Cancel amend and tells the trader they are re-submitting

feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): The review page reads each party's copied address back as name, address lines and country, in live animals and plants, and each uploaded document has its own card showing its file name
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): Addresses card: permanent addresses, CPH format, one header link and a single unfinished entry

feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): Review reads the commodity selection back in a 'What are you importing?' card, groups species under their commodity, and gives identification details their heading, animal labels, own Change link and per-species unfinished messages
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): Review rows for origin, import reason, additional details and transport and arrival follow Design Release 2.1
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): Bring main's identification details and permanent address work into the overview and review branch
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): Review sections and cards take Design Release 2.1's headings, titles and unfinished-card messages
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): The live-animals Transit countries task shows only when transit countries are required
feat(design-release-2-1-overview-and-review): Hub regions for assistive technology, in live animals and plants
